**The paper does not report a UV–vis limit of detection for E. coli.**

In the concentration-dependent section, LOD values are given for only two strains (page 6):

| Strain | CD LOD (OD600) | UV–vis LOD (OD600) |
|---|---|---|
| P. aeruginosa | 0.0034 (Fig. S17a) | 0.0066 (Fig. S17b) |
| L. monocytogenes | 0.0123 (Fig. S17c) | 0.0125 (Fig. S17d) |

E. coli was tested across the same concentration gradient (OD600 = 0.02–0.2), and its signal channels changed consistently with concentration (page 6, Fig. 3b and 3f). The authors state generally that "CD consistently achieved lower limit of detection (LOD) than UV–vis" (page 6), but they give no number for E. coli.

The Supporting Information is not included in the provided document, so I can't check whether an E. coli value appears there.
question: What UV-vis limit of detection was reported for E. coli?
